scope: Recovered PC dispatch, bounded original-code script execution, exact unbound source-name ledger and parser warnings. All addresses are this PC analysis image.

lookup.description: SCP names compare case-insensitively. The game table precedes the built-in table and its first matching entry wins. A null function can still have a valid named definition (PreviousResult).

fields.+0x0e: flags: bit0 chains next condition with AND; bit2 selects packet variable; bit3 dynamic cached operand

scpConditionFlow.description: Bit0 at condition+0x0e joins the next condition with AND. An unmarked passing final record is returned; a failing member skips the remainder of its marked group. Unchained groups are ordered alternatives. PreviousResult has a null handler and reuses the preceding float result.
scpConditionFlow.callback: float handler(system, packet, creature, argument, initializerResult)

scpActionRecords.definitionThirdWord: For actions, low byte causes 0x53db30 animation override handling on first call; for conditions the third word is an initializer callback, not the same field meaning.

scpActionFlow.description: Packet+0x24 timer increments by delta each update. Handler return zero retains current action for another frame; nonzero advances within the same update. Packet+0x50 bit0 marks the first call of an action; the dispatcher clears it before calling the handler and passes firstCall=1.
scpActionFlow.callback: int handler(system, packet, creature, argumentArray, argumentCount, firstCall, frameDelta)
scpActionFlow.stateFlow: Packet+0x04 is script; +0x08 current state; +0x0c current action; +0x10 pending state. Update also handles reference-script interrupts and timed state changes. State entry, named SetState, timed transitions, ordered reference interrupts and stack unwinding now have bounded original-PC checks in gameplay-scp-transition-contract.json.

parserUnknownName.description: Missing SCP action or condition lookup takes the error-report path and continues parsing; the relevant 0x512850/0x512860/0x512870 routines in this PC build are return stubs. Unbound source names are preserved exactly and not silently assigned a similarly spelled handler.

gitKinds.description: Kind0 gizmo, kind1 condition, kind2 action; the output callback is separate from the process callback.

rules.lookup: Case insensitive; game table wins over built-in, first name entry wins; unknown returnsNULL. PreviousResult has a real table entry withNULL handler.
rules.All: All parent output checks nonzero; true for zero parents.
rules.Any: At least one parent output nonzero; false for zero parents.
rules.None: No parent output nonzero; true for zero parents.
rules.Sum: At least threshold parent outputs nonzero; for zero parents true only for zero threshold. Counts booleans, not magnitudes.
rules.Exactly: Number of nonzero parent outputs equals threshold.
rules.Loop: Requires all parent outputs, or totalParents-loopSkip when flag0x400 is set. Successful predicate then propagates/reset-walks children; this side effect excluded by zero-child fixtures.

gitScheduler.description: An active node (flags+0x0a bit0) invokes its kind process callback. Success clears active and sets 0x802, activates each child, and recursively processes a child whose generation byte+8 differs, or whose parent is a condition node. Tick generation, condition monitoring, Loop reset traversal and timer propagation now have bounded original-PC checks in gameplay-git-runtime-contract.json. NuSpecial visibility/reversal and saved graph state are now verified in gameplay-reconstruction.json; other physical types remain open.

gitActions.description: After parent outputs pass, the action node walks records at node+0x0c in order. Each record has next+0, argumentArray+4, count+8, definition+0xc; non-null definition+4 receives (flow,node,argumentArray,count).

parserWarnings.interpretation: Warnings come from the source-preserving catalog parser, not the native engine. Original source lines are preserved; malformed quotes, duplicate/legacy directives and permissive native parsing can differ.

remaining: Inter-script transitions have bounded native verification; full gameplay action behavior and dynamic condition operands remain open. See gameplay-command-semantic-coverage.json for every shipped command name.

GIT timer/random callbacks, monitored conditions and Loop resets are verified separately; NuSpecial callbacks and saved graph-state restoration are verified in gameplay-reconstruction.json; other physical types and source Collapse loading remain open.
Broad adjacent-pointer scan candidates are retained separately from registered dispatch proof.
Malformed or obsolete-looking source lines are not rewritten.
